title: Visa rule
description: One record: the entry requirement for holders of one nationality's passport visiting one destination country. Voyager use: visa.requirement (visa_type, max_stay_days, requirements, processing_time, fee_usd, official_url, notes).

destination_country.description: The country being entered, in English.

nationality.description: The passport country the rule applies to, in English ("all" if it applies to every nationality).

nationality_code.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 of `nationality`; leave out for "all".

purpose.description: Purpose of travel the rule covers.

max_stay_days.description: Maximum stay in days as stated.

stay_period_rule.description: How the stay limit is counted, as written (e.g. "90 days in any 180-day period").

passport_validity_months.description: Passport validity beyond the stay required, in months.

requirements.description: Documents and conditions (return ticket, funds, photos...).

exemptions.description: Exemptions as written, e.g. holders of a valid US visa or an EU residence permit.

text.description: The price exactly as written on the page, e.g. "€45.00", "from ¥1,500", "Free".

amount.description: The number in `text`, without currency symbols or thousands separators.

currency.description: ISO 4217 code of the currency in `text`; never converted.

unit.description: What the price is for, e.g. "per person", "per night", "per ride".

is_free.description: True only if the page says it is free (tips may still be expected).

effective_date.description: The date the rule takes or took effect, if stated (YYYY-MM-DD).

source_url.description: The page's own link for this item (official site, booking or detail page), copied verbatim from the page.

as_of.description: The "last updated", "valid from" or publication date the page itself states for this information (YYYY-MM-DD).

items.description: A verbatim quote from the page.

evidence.description: Up to 3 short verbatim quotes from the page that support the most important facts.
